1.en: By the night when it covers

2.en: And [by] the day when it appears
2.tj: وَٱلنَّهَارِ إِذَا تَجَلَّىٰ ٢

3.en: And [by] He who created the male and female,
3.tj: وَمَا خَلَقَ ٱلذَّكَرَ وَٱلْأُنثَىٰٓ ٣

5.en: As for he who gives and fears Allah
5.tj: فَأَمَّا مَنْ أَعْطَىٰ وَٱتَّقَىٰ ٥

7.en: We will ease him toward ease.

8.en: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
8.tj: وَأَمَّا مَنۢ بَخِلَ وَٱسْتَغْنَىٰ ٨

10.en: We will ease him toward difficulty.

11.ar: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ
11.en: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
11.tj: وَمَا يُغْنِى عَنْهُ مَالُهُۥٓ إِذَا تَرَدَّىٰٓ ١١

13.en: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
13.tj: وَإِنَّ لَنَا لَلْأَخِرَةَ وَٱلْأُولَىٰ ١٣

14.en: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
14.tj: فَأَنذَرْتُكُمْ نَارًا تَلَظَّىٰ ١٤

15.en: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one.
15.tj: لَا يَصْلَـٰهَآ إِلَّا ٱلْأَشْقَى ١٥

16.en: Who had denied and turned away.

17.en: But the righteous one will avoid it -

18.en: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
18.tj: ٱلَّذِى يُؤْتِى مَالَهُۥ يَتَزَكَّىٰ ١٨

19.ar: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍۢ تُجْزَىٰٓ
19.en: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favor to be rewarded
19.tj: وَمَا لِأَحَدٍ عِندَهُۥ مِن نِّعْمَةٍ تُجْزَىٰٓ ١٩

20.en: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
20.tj: إِلَّا ٱبْتِغَآءَ وَجْهِ رَبِّهِ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ ٢٠

21.en: And he is going to be satisfied.
